entries.en: to divide; to distribute, to apportion

entries.zh: 分派、配给（份额或货物，殖民时期即 repartimiento 摊派）；「打票」＝开票、领取执照或许可
entries.en: to distribute, to allot (a repartimiento); to issue a stamped ticket, to obtain a licence
entries.notes: repartimto. 为 repartimiento 缩写；M 栏 sacar licencia 后的数字 [疑] 不影响词义

entries.zh: 平均分配；把人按次序排开、逐门分派
entries.en: to apportion equally; to distribute or line up people in order
entries.notes: 「o Xente」当读 a la gente；「排門」的分派义靠 L 栏语境推定

entries.en: to pluck out (hair, feathers); to pick off; to peel
entries.notes: M 栏 fia [疑:fia/pia] 记音不确，依西语三义与「摘」定
汉字栏 [疑:勃/卒]，「勃」单字本义为「勃然」，M 栏 pun 与二字音皆不密合

entries.en: at the moment, on the spot; suddenly
all at once, in the same instant
entries.notes: M 栏尾「presto mun scomy」残损，主词对（豁然＝repentinamente）清晰

entries.zh: 反复、一再（重复）；〔「謬」字面为错误、荒诞，与此义不合，存疑〕
entries.notes: R 栏 T99 污损且残，H「謬」与 repetir 不合，义只能据 L 栏定

entries.zh: 一遍又一遍地重复；再过一遍
entries.en: to repeat over and over; to go over once again
entries.notes: 「謬」为记音字（liu），字面义不合，据 H 栏「一過」与 M 栏定其重複义

entries.zh: 胡乱反复地说，疯癫地一再重说
entries.en: to repeat nonsense over and over, like a madman
entries.notes: 西语栏 d'iparate damte 残，推为 disparate/demente；义依「乱謬」定

entries.en: to ring out the bells, to peal the bells
entries.notes: 西语头字 [疑:Repican/Replican]，依 H 栏「闹钟」取 repicar

entries.en: to strike the bell, to beat the bell
sedate and unassuming; honest in the old-fashioned way
entries.notes: 「古道」谓古朴厚道，与 reposado humilde 属近义配对

entries.en: afternoon; the resting time after a meal
